title: Cotic Cascade Gen 2 is Now Shipping
content:
Cotic‘s adventure drop-bar 29er, the Cascade Gen 2, is now available for ordering…

This new version is now in full-on production at Fort in the Czech Republic. This Gen 2 brings refinements to the bike Cotic first launched in 2022 and now features the following updates.

Cotic Cascade Gen 2 Updates

  • Revised rider fit brings a wider window of riders for each size, so it’s easier than ever to get your perfect fit on the bike.
  • Revised geometry on the larger sizes to improve stability under load and for better off-road handling.
  • Updated Reynolds 853 front triangle is lighter.
  • Frames now produced in the EU (Gen1 was made in Taiwan).
  • Longer 44 mm head tube increases front triangle size with no increase in stack or standover, for no-compromise increase in framebag capacity.
  • Revised cable management to better avoid frame bags, luggage, and bottles.
  • Bolt-on mech cable guides from end to end (using our custom 3D-printed clips) mean a clean look if you’re running wireless gears.
  • One-piece CNC brake mount and looped seatstays improve brake feel and caliper clearance.
  • Our own design cast driveside dropouts bring UDH/Transmission/Full Mount SRAM ecosystem compatibility to the bike.

This round, Cotic offers a stock color dubbed Gloss Forest with silver graphics, but if that’s not to your taste, then the brand also has its à la carte custom paint program.

Launched in 2022, the Cascade was originally conceived as a drop-bar 29er that could take on some wilder, more rugged terrain than a trad gravel bike. Up in the Peak District, gravel riding blurs into mountain biking fairly regularly, and Cotic wanted a bike that was light and lively compared to a mountain bike, but allowed the rider to really enjoy the proper off-road trails.

The thing about this being one of the most progressive geometry drop-bar bikes out there is that quite a few people spotted that it can make a pretty special flat-bar ATB/touring/gravel-type bike with an old-school XC sensibility. Flat Bar builds can run anything from a full rigid touring style bike to something more XC with 100 mm suspension forks.

Cascade Gen 2 is available from stock as a frameset, including the Cotic Alpaca fork, for £1,329 UK/approx EUR1,330/approx USD1,600, including shipping. Framesets are zero-duty to EU friends because they’re made in the EU.

Bikes start at £2,749 UK/approx EUR2,635/approx USD3,250, including shipping, for Bronze Drop Bar bikes.

Bronze Flat Bar bikes start at £2,399 UK/approx EUR2,399/approx USD2,870
